problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add a column for $¬A,$ where the truth values are opposite to the corresponding values in the column for $A.$ 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we add a column for $¬A∨B.$ Remember that $¬A∨B$ is true if either $¬A$ is true or $B$ is true. 

| $\,A\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
